blocks.text: [Updated Sept. 25, 2026, 11:51 a.m.] MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday confirmed that he had signed Mary Jane Veloso’s absolute pardon. In a brief media interview in Samar, Marcos was asked whether he had decided on the fate of the former overseas Filipino worker. “Pinirmahan ko na… Pinirmahan ko na yung pardon niya kahapon,” he responded. (I already signed it… I signed her pardon yesterday.) READ: Marcos ‘seriously considering’ pardon for Mary Jane Veloso – Palace He did not provide further details, as he immediately turned around and left after confirming the signing.
